description: This file defines classes related to OAuth2 authentication flows used in a FastAPI project, including form data handling for OAuth2 password flows, various OAuth2 schemes (password, bearer, authorization code), and utility classes for scopes and error handling.

classes.name: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm
classes.description: Dependency class for extracting username, password, scope, client_id, and client_secret from form data in OAuth2 password flow.

classes.name: OAuth2PasswordRequestFormStrict
classes.description: Subclass of OAuth2PasswordRequestForm that enforces the 'grant_type' field to be 'password'.

classes.name: OAuth2
classes.description: Base class for OAuth2 security schemes, to be subclassed for specific OAuth2 flows.

classes.name: OAuth2PasswordBearer
classes.description: OAuth2 flow for bearer token authentication obtained via password flow.

classes.name: OAuth2AuthorizationCodeBearer
classes.description: OAuth2 flow that uses authorization code to obtain bearer token.

classes.name: SecurityScopes
classes.description: Class to define and aggregate OAuth2 security scopes across dependencies.

methods.name: HTTPException make_not_authenticated_error(self)
methods.description: Creates an HTTP 401 error indicating the user is not authenticated.

methods.name: Optional[str] __call__(self, request: Request)
methods.description: Async method to extract and validate the Authorization header for OAuth2 schemes.
